{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: graph/traversal/walker.rs (Rust, graph engine side)

ISSUE: Infinite recursion in walker causing stack growth until guard trips. Three separate incidents, all reproducible with cyclic fixture graph, all verified with module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-05-17]:
- Trigger: Only appeared after rolling restart of fleet
- Root cause: Two writes never wrapped in transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #1392, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1)
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 45 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-09]:
- Trigger: Only appeared for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: Switched deadline to monotonic clock (PR #1618, branch fix/infinite-recursion-2)
- Outcome: Reclaimed 46 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 3 [2026-08-08]:
- Trigger: Only appeared when two requests raced on same key
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in single query (PR #1978, branch fix/infinite-recursion-3)
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 7.7% to under 9 per ten thousand"}
